Trevor — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. Quick checklist from our side so we can process this without a pause to payments:
1) Signed vendor change form (we have it)
2) Bank confirmation letter on company letterhead (we have it)
3) Updated W-9 reflecting the legal name/DBA (if there’s any change)
4) Confirmation of the person authorized to request changes (name + title)

I’m looping in Karthik and Marissa from Payments to make sure routing and the portal record get updated end-to-end. We’ll create a ticket and post the DocuSign link if we need an e-signed authorization.

—Stephanie

- Marissa, can you open a Vendor Update ticket (VUP-) and include these artifacts? Please attach the signed change form, bank letter, and W-9.

Expected timeline: 48–72 hours for verification barring any exceptions. If you need a one-off wire in the interim, let us know and we’ll submit an expedite request (we may need vendor's wire instructions).

Marissa — please also confirm whether the new remit address requires a separate Ship-To change or just the AP remit field.
